create_HungarianMatcher: create a HungarianMatcher instance with custom cost weights for class, bbox, and giou matching
run_HungarianMatcher_forward: run the HungarianMatcher forward pass to match predicted boxes against ground truth targets
build_cost_matrix: build a cost matrix combining classification, L1 bbox, and giou costs for bipartite matching
review_HungarianMatcher_init: review the HungarianMatcher constructor to configure cost_class, cost_bbox, cost_giou, and logsoftmax parameters
summarize_HungarianMatcher: summarize the HungarianMatcher class that solves LSAP to assign predictions to targets using linear sum assignment
